description: This source file defines the MemoryPoolBlock class, which manages individual blocks of memory within a custom memory pool for efficient buffer management. It implements IMemoryOwner<byte> to provide memory ownership semantics, including disposal and leasing, used in the context of a slab-based memory pooling system.

classes.name: MemoryPoolBlock
classes.description: A class that represents a block of memory allocated from a slab in a custom memory pool, handling its lifecycle and interfacing with the pool for efficient reuse.

methods.name: MemoryPoolBlock
methods.description: Constructor for MemoryPoolBlock, initializing a block with reference to its pool and slab, offset, and length, creating a pinned memory segment.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases the memory block back to the pool for reuse.

methods.name: Lease
methods.description: A method intended for leasing the memory block; currently empty indicating possibly a placeholder or a future extension.
